reviewer_preferences.label: Liability & Financial Caps
reviewer_preferences.description: Focus on protecting against uncapped liability and unfavorable payment terms.
reviewer_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Increase sensitivity: Flag any uncapped or one-sided liability as CRITICAL. Mark Net 60+ terms as HIGH risk.
reviewer_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer capped liability suggestions and Net 30/45 payment standard language.

reviewer_preferences.label: Indemnification & Insurance
reviewer_preferences.description: Ensure third-party claim protection and adequate insurance coverage.
reviewer_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: More sensitive to unilateral indemnity. Flag missing 'notice and control of defense' as MEDIUM risk.
reviewer_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer mutual IP infringement indemnity templates.

reviewer_preferences.label: Intellectual Property Rights
reviewer_preferences.description: Prioritize ownership of deliverables and retention of background IP.
reviewer_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag 'Vendor owns everything' as CRITICAL. Flag 'Joint ownership' as HIGH risk.
reviewer_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer 'Work Made for Hire' and assignment to customer templates.

reviewer_preferences.label: Data Privacy & Security
reviewer_preferences.description: Ensure GDPR/CCPA compliance and data breach notification obligations.
reviewer_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag missing DPA or missing 72-hour notification as CRITICAL.
reviewer_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer standard GDPR-compliant notification and usage restriction templates.

reviewer_preferences.label: Termination & Exit Rights
reviewer_preferences.description: Focus on termination for convenience and refund of pre-paid fees.
reviewer_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag 'Unilateral Vendor-only termination' as HIGH. Flag missing 'pro-rata refund' as MEDIUM.
reviewer_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer mutual termination for convenience and pro-rata refund templates.

reviewer_preferences.label: Non-Compete & Exclusivity
reviewer_preferences.description: Watch for broad restrictions on business operations.
reviewer_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag 12+ month post-term non-compete as CRITICAL. Flag broad exclusivity without minimums as HIGH.
reviewer_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer 6-month limited non-compete and narrow exclusivity templates.

reviewer_preferences.label: Governing Law & Disputes
reviewer_preferences.description: Ensure favorable or neutral law and dispute resolution venues.
reviewer_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag foreign jurisdictions as CRITICAL. Flag unfavorable hubs (e.g. Alabama) as HIGH.
reviewer_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer Delaware/New York governing law templates.

reviewer_preferences.label: Assignment & M&A Protection
reviewer_preferences.description: Protect the right to assign the contract during merger or acquisition.
reviewer_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag absolute assignment prohibitions (even for M&A) as HIGH risk.
reviewer_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer 'Permitted for M&A/Sale of Assets' assignment templates.

creator_preferences.label: One-Sided/Aggressive Terms
creator_preferences.description: Flag language that is significantly out of market or overly punitive.
creator_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag any 'sole discretion' or 'absolute performance' language as HIGH. Flag usurious interest rates.

creator_preferences.label: Missing Protective Boilerplate
creator_preferences.description: Ensure the contract includes standard legal protections.
creator_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag missing integration (entire agreement) or severability as MEDIUM risk.
creator_preferences.redline_preference: Suggest adding standard ABA/Market integration and non-waiver clauses.

creator_preferences.label: Market Deviation
creator_preferences.description: Identify terms that deviate from standard commercial practices.
creator_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag deviations from Net 30/45 or 3-5 year confidentiality survival as MEDIUM.
creator_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer templates aligned with 'Practical Law' or 'IACCM' market standards.

creator_preferences.label: Negotiation Bottlenecks
creator_preferences.description: Identify clauses that typically lead to prolonged negotiation.
creator_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag broad audit rights (no notice/unlimited) as HIGH. Flag broad publicity rights.
creator_preferences.redline_preference: Suggest limited, consent-based publicity and audit rights.

creator_preferences.label: Ambiguous Deliverables/Scope
creator_preferences.description: Flag items where obligations are not clearly defined.
creator_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag circular or ambiguous precedence as MEDIUM. Flag undefined deliverables.
creator_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer templates that establish clear hierarchy and reference specific SOWs.

creator_preferences.label: Overbroad Covenants
creator_preferences.description: Flag covenants that are too broad in geography or duration.
creator_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer narrowly tailored duration and geographic scope templates.

creator_preferences.label: Compliance & Audit Gaps
creator_preferences.description: Check for missing regulatory compliance or unfair audit cost-shifting.
creator_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag unilateral compliance or 'Auditee always pays' as MEDIUM risk.
creator_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer mutual compliance and 'Auditee pays only for discrepancy' templates.

creator_preferences.label: Inconsistent Hierarchy
creator_preferences.description: Ensure the relationship between main agreement and attachments is clear.
creator_preferences.risk_threshold_shift: Flag lack of clear hierarchy between master agreement and SOW as MEDIUM.
creator_preferences.redline_preference: Prefer standard 'Master Agreement controls legal terms' hierarchy.
